title: GCP Pub/Sub Publish Input
description: Input schema for publishing a message to Pub/Sub.

project_id.description: GCP project override. Falls back to profile/config default.

topic.description: Pub/Sub topic ID or fully-qualified topic name.

data.description: Message payload as a plain string or base64-encoded payload.

data_encoding.description: Optional payload encoding, for example base64.
